        ### Question
        Levamisole is used as all except -

response.enhanced_information: Levamisole is effectively used as an anthelmintic for ascariasis and acts as an immunostimulant. It paralyzes worms through hyperpolarization of their muscle membranes. There is insufficient evidence to support its use as an immunodepressant at high doses, making this the correct answer to the question of what Levamisole is not used for.
